sys_script_include.description: This script defines a ServiceNow server-side class, ExcelToCMDB, for processing Excel files to create Configuration Item (CI) records in various CMDB tables based on the model category. It uses the GlideExcelParser to read Excel rows and dynamically maps them to appropriate CI tables such as Computers, Mobile Devices, Peripherals, Printers, or Servers.
sys_script_include.name: ExcelToCMDB
